# Sphinx documentation build stack for GLASS.
#
# GLASS is header-only CUDA/C++ (no Python package), so the API reference is
# generated by Doxygen (a system package — install separately, e.g.
# `apt-get install doxygen`) and bridged into Sphinx with Breathe.
# Sphinx 9.2 requires Python 3.13; the receipt box and the Jetson AGX Orin
# build the docs with Python 3.12. Raise this with the local toolchain.
Sphinx==9.1.1
pydata-sphinx-theme==0.23.0
myst-parser==5.1.0
sphinx-design==0.7.0
# Breathe 5.x resolves `doxygenfile` against the Doxygen index name (a bare
# basename) instead of the file's location path, so directory-qualified
# directives such as src/nvidia/l1.cuh no longer resolve
# (breathe-doc/breathe#1084). Stay on 4.x until that is fixed upstream.
breathe==4.36.0
